source:
@@U02934@@
Timid little mouse, scared of my own shadow.
God, and naive! I trusted them—
those gray-bearded old fools and their eternal babble!
They lied is what they did,
lied to me,
lied right out of their crusty ancient books!
Teaching they called it!
Telling me what they knew, they said!
When what they knew they didn’t themselves believe!
Wasting their lives and mine!
But what's that?
Someone back in that cell—
sitting in the gloom.
Coming closer, I can’t believe what I’m seeing.
Still sitting there, just as I left him,
still wrapped in that shaggy fleece.
I thought at the time he was terribly wise;
that, of course, was because I wasn’t.
This time that won't be a problem.
Let’s have at him then!
Well, now, old gentleman
(if your bald, bowed head
is still unmoistened by 勒忒河’s turgid stream),
you may recognize a former student,
who meanwhile has outgrown the master’s rod.
I find you just as I left you.
As for myself,
I return quite another man.

@@U02936@@
I’m glad the bell brought you.
I had no small opinion of you back then.
The caterpillar and chrysalis give fair warning
of the beautiful butterfly to come.
I remember your childish pleasure
in your curly head and lace collar.
BAUS PART ewio! ° e251
translation:
@@U02934@@
胆小的小老鼠，害怕自己的影子。
天啊，天真！我信任他们——
那些白胡子老傻瓜和他们永远的胡言乱语！
他们所做的就是撒谎，
对我撒谎，
他们那套硬皮古书中的谎言！
他们称之为教学！
他们说，告诉我他们所知道的！
当他们知道的时候，他们自己却不相信！
浪费他们的生命和我的生命！
但那是什么？
那个牢房里有人——
坐在昏暗中。
走近了，我简直不敢相信自己所看到的。
就在我离开他时，他仍然坐在那里，
仍然裹在那件毛茸茸的羊毛里。
我当时觉得他非常聪明。
当然，那是因为我不是。
这次就不会有问题了。
那我们就来对付他吧！
好吧，现在，老先生
（如果你秃顶、低着头
仍未被勒忒河的湍急溪流滋润），
你可能认识以前的学生，
与此同时，他的成长已经超出了主人的手杖的范围。
我找到你就像我离开你一样。
至于我自己，
我回来时完全变了一个人。

@@U02936@@
我很高兴铃声把你带来。
那时我对你的看法不小。
毛毛虫和蛹给出了合理的警告
美丽的蝴蝶即将来临。
我记得你幼稚的快乐
在你的卷发头和蕾丝领子里。
BAUS 部分 eio！ °e251
